title: System Design: SDE-2 → SDE-3
description: Design systems that scale and defend them in an interview: the requirements → estimate → API → data → deep-dive framework, load balancing / caching / CDN, replication & sharding, consistency & CAP, async messaging & backpressure, reliability & SLOs, and worked designs (URL shortener, news feed, chat, rate limiter, payment ledger).
